sum: An SDK for the loop you would otherwise write yourself: turn limits, token budgets, cancellation and stop reasons as first-class controls, running in your own process with no hosted control plane.
art: agent definitions in Python or TypeScript (persistent)

evidence.co.standards: cites standards_conformance.evidence: conforms to 2 of the 5 neutral interface standards (MCP, AGENTS.md)
evidence.se.residency: cites data_residency: local-first, the operator's state stays on their machine; keys are the operator's own (byok)
evidence.se.threats: cites th and ctrl: T2/T4/T12 introduced, controls limits impl, kill impl, log impl, approval part, agentauth none, sandbox none
evidence.sf.reach: restates exec and ctrl: the entry executes, and its reach is bounded by approval part, sandbox none
evidence.fx.exit: artifact.format code: source files in the repository's own language, readable without the tool
evidence.pe.budget: a ceiling the operator sets on the command line: strands-mcp/pyproject.toml (--timeout=)
evidence.ic.error: documented only, nothing in the code checks: site/src/content/docs/integrations/integrations/welt.mdx (human-in-the-loop)
evidence.rl.resume: a checkpoint or restore path in the code: strands-ts/src/index.ts (Checkpoint)
evidence.fx.install: only a global install is documented: README.md (pip install s)
evidence.fx.byo: the provider is the operator's choice: BEDROCK, OLLAMA, LITELLM (README.md)

pre: the engineering capacity to build the agent yourself
anti: wanting a finished product rather than a library
teams with no appetite to own the loop they run
gnote: Turn limits, token budgets and cancellation are implemented as SDK surface rather than left to the caller, which is rare: most of this layer treats the cap as somebody else's problem. No hosted control plane means nothing leaves the process unless the operator sends it.

ja.sum: 自分で書くことになるループを、SDKとして持つもの。ターン上限・トークン予算・キャンセル・停止理由を一級の制御として備え、ホストされた管理面を持たず自分のプロセス内で動く。
ja.art: PythonまたはTypeScriptによるエージェント定義（永続）
pre: エージェントを自分で組む工数
anti: ライブラリではなく完成品が欲しい場合
走らせるループを自分で持つ気のないチーム
ja.gnote: ターン上限・トークン予算・キャンセルが呼び出し側任せではなくSDKの面として実装されている。この層の多くが上限を他人の問題として扱う中では珍しい。ホストされた管理面がないので、運用者が送らない限り何もプロセス外へ出ない。
